t: A block and JavaScript editor with a simulator for the BBC micro:bit.
steps: Open makecode.microbit.org in a browser and start a project.
Try the simulator with a short program.
Download the file and copy it to the board, or pair by WebUSB in a supported browser.
Install the Windows or Mac app for offline use.
Teach students to export their projects as files.
Skip sign in unless the school approves cloud saving.
